gloss: stepchild, child from a previous marriage

definitions.gloss: stepchild, child from a previous marriage
definitions.explanation: A child that one's spouse brings into a new marriage from a previous relationship.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{連|つ}れ{子|こ}がいる。
examples.english: She has a child from a previous marriage.

examples.japanese: {連|つ}れ{子|こ}も{自分|じぶん}の{子|こ}と{同|おな}じように{愛|あい}している。
examples.english: I love my stepchild just the same as my own child.

examples.japanese: {再婚|さいこん}する{時|とき}、お{互|たが}いに{連|つ}れ{子|こ}がいた。
examples.english: When we remarried, we each had children from previous marriages.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {連|つ}れる (to bring along) + {子|こ} (child) - literally 'a child brought along.'

RELATED WORDS:
- {継子|ままこ}: stepchild (alternative term, sometimes with negative connotations as in fairytales)
- {義理|ぎり}の{子|こ}: stepchild (more formal)
- {再婚|さいこん}: remarriage

USAGE:
{連|つ}れ{子|こ} is a neutral, commonly used term in modern Japanese for discussing blended families.
